question: Compare a continuous spectrum and an atomic line spectrum on the basis of their appearance and origin.

options.A: A continuous spectrum contains separate bright lines, while an atomic line spectrum is an unbroken band of colours.
options.B: Both continuous and atomic line spectra contain all wavelengths without gaps; only their brightness differs.
options.C: A continuous spectrum is formed only by atoms emitting definite wavelengths, while an atomic line spectrum is formed by hot solids.
options.D: A continuous spectrum is an unbroken range of wavelengths without gaps. An atomic line spectrum consists of separate lines at definite wavelengths because atoms emit or absorb only selected wavelengths; it is discontinuous and characteristic of the atom.
